actions.name: prepend_note_agenda
actions.description: Prepend To Note Agenda. Add Fellow Markdown to the start of a note's agenda, leaving the rest of the content in place.

note_id.description: The note's id; list_notes lists them

content_fellow_markdown.description: Fellow Markdown to add at the start of the agenda, in the same format the note object's content_fellow_markdown field returns.

actions.name: append_note_agenda
actions.description: Append To Note Agenda. Add Fellow Markdown to the end of a note's agenda, leaving the rest of the content in place.

note_id.description: The note's id; list_notes lists them

content_fellow_markdown.description: Fellow Markdown to add at the end of the agenda, in the same format the note object's content_fellow_markdown field returns.

actions.name: find_replace_note_agenda
actions.description:
Find And Replace In Note Agenda. Replace the single occurrence of `find` in a note's agenda with Fellow Markdown.

`find` must match exactly once. A missing or ambiguous match is a 422 and changes nothing.

note_id.description: The note's id; list_notes lists them

find.description: Existing agenda text to replace. Must appear exactly once, or the request is rejected.

content_fellow_markdown.description: Fellow Markdown to substitute for the matched text, in the same format the note object's content_fellow_markdown field returns. An empty string deletes the matched text.

actions.name: replace_note_agenda
actions.description:
Replace Note Agenda. Write a note's agenda and/or rename the note. Provide `content_fellow_markdown`, `title`, or both.

`content_fellow_markdown` replaces the entire agenda with the provided Fellow Markdown.

`title` renames the note, the same as renaming it in the Fellow app.

note_id.description: The note's id; list_notes lists them

content_fellow_markdown.description: The full agenda body in Fellow Markdown, the same format the note object's content_fellow_markdown field returns. When provided, replaces the existing agenda content.

title.description: New title for the note. When provided, renames the note.

actions.description: Retrieve Action Item. Retrieve an action item by its ID.

action_item_id.description: The action item's id; list_action_items lists them

actions.name: list_action_items
actions.description:
List action items with optional filters and pagination.
Privileged access allows you to get action items for the account.
Non-privileged access allows you to get action items for the authenticated user only.

The `scope` filter controls which action items are returned:
- (no scope - default): All action items the user has access to
- assigned_to_me: Only action items assigned to the authenticated user
- assigned_to_others: Only action items the user can edit, assigned to teammates

The `created_at_start`, `created_at_end`, `updated_at_start` and `updated_at_end` filters take a
YYYY-MM-DD date or an ISO datetime and are inclusive. A value without a time means midnight UTC, so
pass a time o...

pagination.description: Parameters sent in a request to paginate a queryset.

order_by.description: Supported ordering options for action items.

created_at_start.description: Only return action items created at or after this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO datetime, and is inclusive. A value without a time means midnight UTC, so an end bound of 2024-01-05 excludes everything later that day.

created_at_end.description: Only return action items created at or before this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO datetime, and is inclusive. A value without a time means midnight UTC, so an end bound of 2024-01-05 excludes everything later that day.

updated_at_start.description: Only return action items updated at or after this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO datetime, and is inclusive. A value without a time means midnight UTC, so an end bound of 2024-01-05 excludes everything later that day. Whether updated_at moves depends on where the change was made. Edits in the note itself, including its text, completion, assignees and due date, all bump updated_at. An assignee or due date changed outside the note, such as from the action items list, is written to a separate record and leaves updated_at unchanged, so this filter does not pick that item up.

updated_at_end.description: Only return action items updated at or before this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO datetime, and is inclusive. A value without a time means midnight UTC, so an end bound of 2024-01-05 excludes everything later that day. Whether updated_at moves depends on where the change was made. Edits in the note itself, including its text, completion, assignees and due date, all bump updated_at. An assignee or due date changed outside the note, such as from the action items list, is written to a separate record and leaves updated_at unchanged, so this filter does not pick that item up.

actions.name: create_webhook
actions.description:
Create Webhook. Create a new webhook endpoint.

Creates a webhook that will receive HTTP POST requests when subscribed events occur.
The webhook will be associated with the authenticated user.

Set `scope` to `workspace` to create an account-wide webhook instead, which receives every
matching event in the account and is delivered once per event rather than once per attendee.
**Super Admin Access Required** for that value: a key acting through `X-On-Behalf-Of` cannot
create one, because impersonation drops privileged access.

url.description: The URL endpoint that will receive webhook POST requests

enabled_events.description: List of event types to subscribe to. Valid values: 'ai_note.shared_to_channel', 'ai_note.generated', 'action_item.assigned', 'action_item.completed'.

description.description: Optional description for this webhook endpoint

scope.description: Who the webhook belongs to. 'user' is the authenticated user, the default and the existing behaviour. 'workspace' is the whole account: it receives every matching event with no per-user filter, and each event is delivered once rather than once per attendee. Creating one requires a privileged API key.

actions.name: get_webhook
actions.description: Retrieve Webhook. Retrieve a webhook by its ID.

webhook_id.description: The webhook's id; list_webhooks lists them

actions.name: update_webhook
actions.description:
Update Webhook. Update an existing webhook endpoint.

Allows partial updates - only provided fields will be modified.
The webhook must belong to the authenticated user (or account for privileged access).

An account-wide webhook is updated through this same endpoint, and needs a privileged key:
without one its id reads as not found, the same answer as another user's webhook.

`scope` cannot be changed after creation, and is ignored here: a webhook's scope decides
which Svix application its endpoint lives in, so converting one means deleting and
recreating it.

webhook_id.description: The webhook's id; list_webhooks lists them

url.description: The URL endpoint that will receive webhook POST requests

enabled_events.description: List of event types to subscribe to. Valid values: 'ai_note.shared_to_channel', 'ai_note.generated', 'action_item.assigned', 'action_item.completed'.

description.description: Optional description for this webhook endpoint

actions.name: delete_webhook
actions.description:
Delete Webhook. Delete a webhook endpoint by its ID.

An account-wide webhook is deleted through this same endpoint, and needs a privileged key:
without one its id reads as not found.

webhook_id.description: The webhook's id; list_webhooks lists them

actions.name: list_webhooks
actions.description:
List webhooks with optional filters and pagination.

Query Parameters:
- page_size: Number of results per page (optional, default: 20, max: 50)
- cursor: Pagination cursor for next page (optional)
- filters: JSON-encoded WebhookFilters (optional)
  Example: ?filters={"status":"active","created_at_start":"2024-01-01"}

Returns a list of webhooks for the authenticated user. Privileged access
allows listing all webhooks for the account.
